subject: MSA/Order Form redlines — DPA role crosswalk & SCCs execution playbook
messages:
From: Samira Khan <legal@starnova.com>
To: ava.chen@redwood-inference.com
Cc: j.doan@starnova.com, procurement@starnova.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Starnova redlines + SCCs preference (first pass)

Hi Ava —

Attached are Starnova's first-pass redlines to the MSA and Order Form plus a separate SCCs preference spreadsheet. A few quick asks from our side:

- We noted several DPA role items where Starnova expects 'Controller' obligations for certain telemetry/usage logs. Please confirm Redwood's position and any operational mitigations (e.g., deletion windows / region-limited logs).
- On SCC selection: Starnova prefers the newer EU Commission standard clauses with the Additional Safeguards box ticked — can Redwood confirm compatibility with Dedicated/Private deployments?
- We need a mutual action plan with owners and dates so procurement can clear timelines for our legal ops.

We've flagged a couple of policy exceptions in the doc (see comments). Can you route to the right folks internally (legal, security, and sales ops)?

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Senior Counsel, Starnova Health
legal@starnova.com

Attachments: Starnova_MSARedlines_20270503.docx, SCCs-selector_matrix_20270504.xlsx

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <legal@starnova.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood-inference.com, hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com, karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starnova redlines + SCCs preference (first pass)

Hi Samira — thanks, received.

Quick plan:
1) Ben (legal) will take lead on the MSA/DPA clause redlines and produce a redline with our proposed compromise by EOD Wed (05/05).
2) Karhtik (security & infra) and Hannah (procurement ops) will validate the SCCs matrix vs our hosting modes and highlight where Dedicated/Private can meet the "Additional Safeguards" ask.
3) I'll draft a mutual action plan (owners + dates) and share a one-pager for procurement.

Two quick clarifying Qs for you before we loop in Ben/Hannah/Karthik formally:
- When you reference telemetry logs as Controller-level obligations — can you point to the exact sections/annotations in the spreadsheet where Starnova marked that? I couldn't find the comment thread on page 4.
- Are you expecting a hard data residency certification (e.g., signed hosting addendum) or operational commitments in the Order Form? Both are workable but change the timeline.

I'll get Ben on this thread in a minute.

Best,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood-inference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <legal@starnova.com>, ava.chen@redwood-inference.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com, karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Mon, 4 May 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starnova redlines + SCCs preference (first pass)

Samira / Ava —

Thanks for the materials. I reviewed the MSA redlines and the SCCs spreadsheet. High-level notes:

- DPA role mapping: Redwood's default position is controller for customer-provided data and processor for telemetry that is strictly service performance telemetry. We can narrow the telemetry scope and add an operational SLA for log retention and region-limiting. Suggest language: "Redwood will retain runtime operational logs for debugging for up to 30 days, stored in the region specified in the Order Form unless otherwise agreed."

- SCCs: the newer Commission clauses are fine for Hosted and Dedicated. For Private (customer-managed VPC or on-prem) we typically require a short annex confirming hosting topology; we can provide a templated hosting addendum for Starnova to sign that maps the Additional Safeguards.

- Exceptions: There are two carveouts Starnova requested that have material security implications (cross-border dev access, and longer telemetry retention). We need product & infra sign-off for any exceptions. Karhtik — can you confirm whether we can certify the Additional Safeguards for Dedicated in eu-west-1 and provide evidence artifacts?

Next steps I propose: I will produce a consolidated redline and a short comment table with our rationale. Ava, please create the MAP (mutual action plan) doc with owners/dates and link to this thread. Hannah — I may need procurement alignment on whether the hosting addendum goes in the Order Form or as a separate exhibit.

Ben Carter
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Starnova_MSARedlines_20270503.docx (comments applied)

From: Karhtik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood-inference.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood-inference.com>, Samira Khan <legal@starnova.com>
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 5 May 2027 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starnova redlines + SCCs preference (first pass)

Samira / team —

Checked infra artifacts for Dedicated eu-west-1: we can provide region-scoped runtime logs, KMS key ownership (Redwood-managed) and an encryption-in-transit + at-rest evidence package. We can also add a hosting annex that lists the Additional Safeguards we can attest to (no developer cross-border access, encryption key residency, and restricted operational access).

Caveat: for Private (customer on-prem) we cannot sign control over customer-side network egress; we can provide recommended controls and an operations checklist but the final attestation sits with the customer.

I'll upload the artifacts to the drive link and share a short evidence checklist by EOD.

— Karthik
Director, Infrastructure Security, Redwood Inference

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood-inference.com>
To: Samira Khan <legal@starnova.com>, ben.carter@redwood-inference.com
Cc: hannah.schmitt@redwood-inference.com, karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 6 May 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Starnova redlines + SCCs preference (first pass) — MAP & exec ask

Samira — attached is the one-pager MAP and our proposed compromise redline (Ben's consolidated version). Key dates:

- 05/07: Redwood final redline (Ben) + evidence checklist (Karthik)
- 05/10: Starnova counter-sign or confirm open points (Samira)
- 05/14: Procurement/Legal sign-off and Order Form execution target

Two asks for Starnova:
1) Confirm whether you want the hosting annex signed as an exhibit to the Order Form (preferred) or as an external hosting addendum (may add two weeks).
2) For the telemetry carveout — if you need retention >30 days (e.g., 90d), please confirm exact fields and use-case so Ben/infra can evaluate risk.

If we need an executive exception (for example, to shorten the timeline while we gather evidence), Ben can escalate to Legal leadership; Hannah, please confirm if procurement needs to trigger an exception review.

Thanks — I'll push the MAP to the Drive link in 10 minutes.

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_Starnova_DPA_20270506.pdf, Redwood_compromise_redline_MS A_20270506.docx
